file: examples/streaming/basic_prints.py

from func_to_web import Max, Min, run


def announce(name: str = "world") -> str:
    print(f"hello {name}")
    return f"greeted {name}"


def checklist(items: int = 4) -> str:
    for index in range(1, items + 1):
        print(f"step {index} of {items} done")
    return "done"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run([announce, checklist], title="Hello")
